name: Deeprun Tram
summary: The Deeprun Tram is an subterranean marvel of gnomish engineering linking the Alliance capitals of Ironforge and Stormwind City. Commissioned by King Magni Bronzebeard following the Second War, it allows citizens and soldiers to cross vast distances beneath the earth in mere minutes. The enclosed twin tracks cut beneath mountain and lake, serving as a vital artery for Alliance military support and commerce.

sections.title: A Marvel of Subterranean Engineering
sections.body: Following the devastation of the Second War, King Magni Bronzebeard grew increasingly frustrated with how slowly dwarven aid and construction supplies reached Stormwind across the mountain passes. To solve the logistical hurdle and guarantee that dwarven soldiers could rapidly reinforce the human capital in times of crisis, Magni turned to High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque. The master gnomish engineer drafted designs for an enclosed underground railway powered by cutting-edge technology. Despite excavation complications—including cutting right through a vast subterranean lake and battling relentless infestations of underground rats—the tram became a crowning achievement of the Alliance, moving thousands of travelers free of charge between Ironforge and Stormwind.

faq.q: Why was the Deeprun Tram built?
faq.answer: After the Second War, King Magni Bronzebeard needed a faster way to transport supplies and dwarven troops to assist in rebuilding and defending Stormwind. He commissioned High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque, who drafted and executed the subterranean railway project to seamlessly bind the two capitals together.

faq.q: How does the tram travel underwater?
faq.answer: During the excavation between Dun Morogh and Stormwind, gnomish engineers breached a massive subterranean lake. Rather than routing around it, they constructed a sealed, reinforced glass viewing tunnel directly through the deep water, allowing passengers to watch wild threshadons and sharks swim alongside the track.

faq.q: Why are there so many rats along the tracks?
faq.answer: The damp, dark subterranean shafts provide an ideal breeding ground for vermin. Gnomish station masters constantly struggle to keep the rat population from chewing through cables or overrunning the platforms, occasionally relying on travelers and rat catchers like Monty to cull their numbers.

faq.q: Is the tram free to ride?
faq.answer: Yes. Sponsored as an open civic and military project by the governments of Ironforge and Stormwind, the tram operates continuously and without fare for all citizens and allies of the Alliance.

angles.text: The entire railway is an unparalleled gnomish masterpiece, showcasing advanced track propulsion, pressurized glasswork capable of withstanding subterranean lake depths, and intricate electrical switching stations.
The tram serves as the primary strategic artery connecting the Alliance's two most fortified capitals, allowing for rapid troop redeployment and mutual defense within minutes.
